owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

stop_rules: Stop and post BLOCKED when a criterion cannot pass without weakening a test, skipping a test or relaxing an assertion.
Stop and ask when the work would name a client product, a person, a server or a seat in repository text; the client names live in docs/CLIENTS.md only.
Stop when the work would add a runtime dependency, a model call, a network call at install or start, a second store for project state, or any reporting that is not opt-in and off by default.
Stop when the work would move convergence logic into the core, vendor the engine, or add a merge engine beside the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs.

Stop when the work would implement a federation, replication, trust, admission or computation feature beyond the specification, schema, validator and conformance test the contract names; the product keeps the planned label on it.
If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.

title: SO-F-05 Classification model: six replication classes on notes and entities, local-only by default, refused only on the federation path, and derived data in the index and graph that inherits the source classification
request: Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-F-05) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. Implements the design records SO-2.02 (Permission-aware knowledge access: retrieval governed by identity, project membership, classification, policy and jurisdiction); SO-2.03 (Provenance, retention and invalidation of organisational knowledge) (contracts/scope-one/specs). The decision record cites this contract by id and keeps only the gaps this one does not cover. Memev contracts that land first: SO-F-02, SO-F-04. Page: docs/DATA-SOVEREIGNTY.md comes from the federation architecture documentation (PR #223, branch docs/federation-architecture, not on main); until that merges, the first contract to need a page creates it with its Status section, labelled planned or architectural target, and the later ones extend it. Source in the fold: #222 section 13.5 and 13.6.1 (replication classes, derived data) and #223 DATA-SOVEREIGNTY.md (replication classes 1 to 6, acceptance criteria 2 and 3). Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) Decision verifier D-SO-TOPOLOGY removed (settled: local-first). (4) Boundary with PG-13.1 WP13-01 (sharing classes enforced at the publish boundary): this contract owns the six-class classification, the local-only default and inheritance by derived data; WP13-01 enforces at the publish boundary using these classes and should map its shared and local-only groups onto them. (5) Backup rule stated to match the owner decision: the whole-vault git backup, run every few minutes, is the recovery copy class by definition.
